opportunities.title: [Idea] AVO Verified Research Exchange for On-Chain Science and Data Bounties
opportunities.summary: ## Idea Summary - **Idea Title**: AVO Verified Research Exchange for On-Chain Science and Data Bounties - **Core Analysis**: The AVO demonstration matters because it suggests agents can solve unfamiliar multi-step problems with less hand-holding than current tools. Most Web3 agent ideas are still centered on trading, auditing, or task delegation, but a more durable opportunity is research workflow automation: finding data, validating sources, testing hypotheses, and producing reproducible outputs.
